observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 157.» (L4, beside the head of chapter 44) and «p. 158.» (L28) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the head of chapter 44: 5 stands beside «CAPUT XLIV.», 10 beside the last line of the title, 15 beside L11.
body L4-L7: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type; «CAPUT XLIV.» is centred, the title is set as a paragraph of three lines, the second and the third indented.
body L1, L2: the d of «gradus» and the o of «orientis» are printed broken.
body L34: specks stand under the t and the i of «tertia» at the end of the line; they are not signs.
body L17, L38: specks stand over the d of «divide» and under the l of «paral-»; they are not signs.
body L37-L38: the words from «Si autem» to the end of the page are italic.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
